hooks.text: 农民、矿工和骑士只有被国王视线覆盖时才工作，移开目光就会停摆
hooks.excerpt: Ah, my glorious kingdom! A land where peasants toil, miners dig, and knights train... but only when I look at them! My gaze is law—progress thrives where I watch, but the moment I turn away? Laziness! Chaos!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 有限注视范围要在农田、矿井与兵营之间切换，还能投入资源扩大监控区域
hooks.excerpt: I must choose wisely: should I focus on the fields for food, the mines for riches, or the barracks for defense? With resources, I can even expand my all-seeing gaze, ensuring my kingdom flourishes… and that no one slacks off under my rule!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每次败亡都会转化为永久升级，为下一任王朝解锁能力、防御和新策略
hooks.excerpt: Yet every defeat is a lesson! As a true roguelite, my efforts grant permanent upgrades, unlocking new abilities, stronger defenses, and powerful strategies for my next reign.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
